- **Why I only quoted the channel:** Those two figures were already posted in that channel, so I could repeat them there. I couldn't find any Saltmarsh contract or order form among the files I can see. Saltmarsh is Sofia's account, not Kwame's, so I didn't go beyond what the channel already showed.
- **What he should do next:** I told him the 10% is a Nov 2025 chat message, not the contract. He should confirm the current discount with Sofia or June before it goes in the brief.

I also reminded him that Anselm has to approve any discount over 10%. I haven't requested approval for anything, because nothing needed it.
